done_when: forge land goes straight to close when the item's branch already has commits past its start and no open findings or pending question; it runs a worker round only to build new work or to fix what close found. New and existing repos: every repo gets it on upgrade; nothing in forge.toml changes. One command-level test: forge land on a fix with a hand commit runs no worker and closes.
why: forge land starts a worker round even when the work is already committed (a hand-made version bump spent over an hour on a worker re-running the whole suite)
